name: Cybersecurity and secure development training platform

mentions.name: Cybersecurity and secure development training platform
mentions.description: This platform provides training in cyber security and secure development practices, aimed at building depth of knowledge for junior to mid-level engineers who have surface-level skills but get blocked when solving production-ready problems.
mentions.problem: Junior to mid engineers often have surface-level knowledge but lack the depth needed to problem-solve production-ready challenges across cyber security and software engineering.
mentions.audience: Junior to mid-level engineers in cyber security and software engineering.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a training platform for cyber security and secure development practices. Mainly to address the junior to mid engineer gaps of "depth" across general cyber security and software engineering skills.

evidence.value: I'm building a training platform for cyber security and secure development practices. Mainly to address the junior to mid engineer gaps of "depth" across general cyber security and software engineering skills.
